title: Cell round trip: trivial cells and a 1,000-row data frame
label: Cell round trip
description: Runs 1,000 trivial cells in one session, and a cell whose value is a 1,000-row phibble data frame 100 times. Each data-frame cell formats the frame into its MIME bundle: text, the HTML table, and the bundle's metadata. The two no-kernel rows time the same formatting in one PHP process. phibble's text output prints only the first rows of a frame, as the HTML table does, so neither formats all 1,000 rows.
workload: 1,000 cells of 1; and 100 cells returning a 1,000-row, 5-column data frame

implementations.juphyter kernel: the php kernel through jupyter_client: ipykernel transport plus the PHP engine
implementations.PHP engine alone: php bin/juphyter engine, driven over its Unix socket
implementations.python3 ipykernel: a stock ipykernel Python kernel running 1

method: Kernel rows: from sending execute_request to receiving the execute_reply and the idle status. PHP engine alone: from writing the execute request to the socket to the engine's ok event. No-kernel rows: hrtime around the expression. Each repetition is a new session with 20 (trivial) or 3 (data frame) warmup cells; the value is the median over the repetitions' per-cell medians. Building the data frame is excluded.
time_spent_in: The PHP engine alone row is the PHP process: parsing and running the cell and formatting its value. The juphyter kernel row adds Jupyter (ZeroMQ messaging and ipykernel) and the Python transport's socket hop. The no-kernel rows are formatting alone, in PHP.
memory_method: peak_rss_mib: VmHWM of the PHP engine process from /proc/<pid>/status after the trivial cells, the engine only, without the Python transport or Jupyter. php_peak_mib: memory_get_peak_usage(true) in the engine after the trivial cells.
